entities.name: Query CTP synthase
observations: 540 aa soluble enzyme with predicted molecular weight 59.8 kDa and theoretical pI 6.80.
Contains CTP_synth_N domain at residues 7–271 and GATase domain at residues 307–529; a weak Peptidase_C26 match overlaps residues 372–513.
Matches reviewed bacterial CTP synthases over 99% query coverage with 65.7–68.3% identity and E-values of 2.3e-262 to 6.0e-275.
Likely catalyzes ATP-dependent amination of UTP to CTP using glutamine or ammonia, with glutaminase production of ammonia as the alternative nitrogen-delivery route.

Likely participates in de novo CTP biosynthesis and pyrimidine nucleotide metabolism; exact regulation and oligomeric state are inferred from homologs rather than experimentally demonstrated for this sequence.
